অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়
অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ
(কাস্টমস ও মূল্য সংযোজন কর)
প্রজ্ঞাপন
তারিখ : ১৯ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৩ বঙ্গাব্দ/২ জুন, ২০১৬ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh, specifically the Ministry of Finance, acts as the issuing authority for this statutory regulatory order.
Ministry of Finance: This ministry holds the administrative authority over the Internal Resources Division and oversees the issuance of customs and tax-related notifications.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance is the specific government department responsible for issuing this regulatory notification concerning customs and value added tax matters.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act serves as the legal basis for the government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend notifications concerning customs duties.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legislative authority for the government to issue regulatory orders relating to value-added tax in the public interest.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as the primary advisory body to the government in the issuance and amendment of customs and tax-related statutory regulatory orders.
S.R.O. 147-AIN/2013: This existing notification is being amended through the replacement of its specified table of goods to update the list of items subject to regulatory provisions.
Animal Feed and Veterinary Products: This order updates the specific list of H.S. codes and descriptions for various items, including feed supplements, veterinary medicines, and related industrial additives, covered under this regulatory framework.
H.S. Code: The table provides a consolidated list of H.S. codes subject to these regulations, covering categories from coral materials and agricultural grains to complex veterinary medicaments and laboratory reagents.
